description: Fréquentation en gares is a dataset listed in Tarn et Garonne Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gares & connexions. Ce jeu de données représente la fréquentation annuelle de l’ensemble des 3000 gares voyageurs de 2015 à 2022. Coverage: Tarn-et-Garonne. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are sncf, gares, gares-de-voyageurs, frequentation, transport. The portal shows 16 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-01-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-82amenagement-fr-portal.
